SELECT p.id, p.member_id, pc.name AS category_name, p.title, p.view_count, p.like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED') AS comment_count, p.created_at
FROM posts p JOIN post_categories pc ON pc.id = p.category_id
ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT #{rankingDate}, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.popularity_score DESC, s.post_id DESC), s.post_id, s.popularity_score, s.view_count, s.like_count, s.comment_count
FROM ( SELECT e.post_id, SUM(e.view_count) AS view_count, SUM(e.like_count) AS like_count, SUM(e.comment_count) AS comment_count, SUM(e.view_count) * 1 + SUM(e.like_count) * 25 + SUM(e.comment_count) * 15 AS popularity_score
FROM ( SELECT post_id, 1 AS view_count, 0 AS like_count, 0 AS comment_count FROM post_views WHERE
UNION ALL
SELECT post_id, 0 AS view_count, 1 AS like_count, 0 AS comment_count FROM post_likes WHERE
UNION ALL
SELECT post_id, 0 AS view_count, 0 AS like_count, 1 AS comment_count FROM ( SELECT post_id, member_id FROM comments WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND GROUP BY post_id, member_id ) commenters ) e
JOIN posts p ON p.id = e.post_id AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
GROUP BY e.post_id ORDER BY popularity_score DESC, e.post_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) s

FROM daily_popular_posts d JOIN posts p ON p.id = d.post_id JOIN post_categories pc ON pc.id = p.category_id
